items.scope: 206 VLMs/31 multimodal benchmarks; sample-level sequential assumptions.
AgentSuite committed trajectories and audit-filter splits.
items.uncertainty: Filtering does not prove every removed task invalid.

items.scope: 13 model-domain cells, 7 model families, 3 domains, n=30 paired tasks/cell.
items.uncertainty: Explicit correction is not guaranteed final-answer improvement.

items.candidate: Evaluate failure monitor jointly with its intervention via recovery/disruption.
items.scope: HotPotQA, GAIA, ALFWorld failure-monitor interventions across 3 agents.

items.candidate: Measure judge error correlation/effective independent vote count.

items.uncertainty: Open-ended O evaluation differs from classification/preference settings.

items.scope: Terminal-Bench 2.1, matched K=5 compute, with/without tests, 45/10/34 disjoint split.
items.uncertainty: One study/two-run averages; official code, no independent numerical rerun found.

items.scope: Valid e-CIs/e-processes; 263 Twitter A/B experiments plus K≤1000 simulations.
items.uncertainty: Cannot repair an invalid marginal process from a wrong dependence model.

items.scope: Finite-design simulation ranking/selection with common random numbers.
items.uncertainty: Transfer to semantic agent evaluation untested; correlation estimates can be noisy.

Trigger verification on decision/rank instability while preserving search depth.
items.scope: 30 noisy COCO functions×15 instances plus 6 external tasks under fixed budgets.
items.uncertainty: Black-box objective noise is not semantic judge bias; extreme noise can remain uninformative.

items.candidate: Anytime-valid paired acceptor for repeated self-modification.
items.scope: Qwen2.5 prompt self-evolution on GSM8K, SVAMP, ARC-Challenge.
items.uncertainty: Per-decision guarantee, not lineage-wide FWER under endogenous edits.

items.candidate: Quantile-calibrated persistent drift alarms with post-alarm freeze and explicit FAR/delay tradeoffs.
items.scope: Tabular/sensor/data-stream drift detection under TFIDD's tested benchmarks and fixed-parameter settings.
items.result: SEA FAR 0.0278±0.0048/delay 4.10±1.16 chunks; Gas FAR 0.0023±0.0047/delay 3.11±1.93; CoverType no-freeze shortens delay 2.92→2.14 but raises FAR 0.0215→0.0242.
items.uncertainty: CoverType FAR/delay are proxy-derived; released repo lacks runnable detector code; no independent numerical rerun; transfer to O semantic drift is untested.

items.candidate: Allocate audit/checkpoint budget by verification age times downstream causal exposure.
items.scope: Multi-agent dependency-graph auditing under the paper's corruption/attack settings.
items.result: Fixed-budget causal-exposure audit placement beats random at comparable tokens and reports 17.2–40.6% token reductions versus heavier guards, with budget/weight ablations and false-positive disruption curves.
items.uncertainty: No independent replication/public artifact audit in this wave; single-agent O transfer and historical rewind-target selection remain untested.

items.candidate: Separate causal-object fault localization from temporal rollback-target selection in long-horizon recovery.
items.scope: Discrete spatial/topological graph-memory construction and repair in synthetic/TextWorld/MANGO-style settings.
items.result: Controlled root-cause/impact and version-control ablations show both positive and negative cells plus a sharply non-monotonic repair-budget effect, supporting selective object repair rather than undifferentiated rewind.
items.uncertainty: Version rollback is not uniformly beneficial; generalization beyond graph memory and safe stochastic-repair stopping are untested.

items.candidate: Conformal selective pairwise judging with explicit abstention when accepted-set risk cannot be supported.
items.scope: Pairwise LLM judging with exchangeable calibration/test conditions; corruption applied to calibration labels.
items.result: At α=0.10 accepted-set risk is ~0.097–0.099 with strong RewardBench coverage/up to 2.4× coverage; a 0–20% calibration-label corruption sweep causes conservative coverage collapse rather than hidden risk inflation.
items.uncertainty: Exchangeability can fail under search-distribution shift; needs online recalibration/shift detection and a stronger fallback verifier.

items.candidate: Dynamically widen reasoning/search branching by state value and unexplored policy mass instead of a fixed branch count.
items.scope: Historical Lean Mathlib and Isabelle/PISA theorem-proving setups with the paper's policy/value models and expansion budgets.
items.result: Dynamic state branching improves theorem success most under low compute; trajectory/value ablations and a 53% truncation observation show that both compute allocation and raw-history context length matter.
items.uncertainty: Historical models are weaker; O-specific action sets, compressed trajectories, value calibration and modern multi-action costs are untested.

items.candidate: Route each scientific failure class to the observability channel that can actually detect it, then gate promotion on the routed evidence.
items.scope: Released AI CFD Scientist production VLM validation path and constructed 20-case planted-failure/clean-control harness.
items.result: 14/16 planted failures detected, but all 4 clean controls were also flagged in the reduced harness (precision 77.8%) and convergence-not-settled recall was only 2/4.
items.uncertainty: Supports observability-matched routed validation, not a universal VLM verifier; requires clean-control calibration and a deterministic convergence channel.

items.candidate: Layer long-horizon self-improvement with a locked audit set, anchor-validity guards and an outside judge to limit evaluator/skill co-adaptation.
items.scope: 100-round MBPP+, Spider 2.0-Snow and report-generation loops under anchored metric/skill co-evolution.
items.result: Three-seed experiments retain 88–110% held-out lift across 100 rounds and document a Goodhart failure/repair; official implementation exposes round-by-round artifacts and run commands.
items.uncertainty: Held-out sets are only 40–48 items; no anytime-valid/global repeated-testing budget, generic semantic pre-commit gate, or independent numerical rerun.

items.candidate: Use one bounded finalized statistic per completed task and a time-uniform confidence sequence for the running average conditional mean.
items.scope: Bounded task-level statistics over the realized/adaptive task sequence; one task remains the outer statistical unit.
items.result: Nonasymptotic anytime-valid inference tolerates heterogeneous task expectations and avoids treating correlated within-task rollouts as independent observations.
items.uncertainty: Does not itself prove population generalization or validate an adaptively gamed task summary; practical power at O-like n≈10–50 must be measured.
